name: Numerical Weather Prediction GRIB2 Parser Node
description: Parser flow node (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64) for numerical-weather-prediction model fields in GRIB2 (NOAA/NCEP GFS and GEFS from NOAA Open Data Dissemination's anonymous public buckets, fetched message by message through the .idx inventory). parse reads the HttpResponses (HRSP) of the byte ranges, each carrying its job in CONTEXT - the size-prefixed $WXF header record nwp-field-source's plan built for the (product, lead): FIELD_ID <model_key>:<run>:f<LLL>:<product>, VARIABLE_NAME the product, MODEL_CLASS/MODEL_ID, LEAD_HOURS, MEMBER_KIND/ENSEMBLE_SIZE, GRID.DLAT the records' spacing (the stride), GRID.NLAT the rows a record, TILE_COUNT the square tiles, SOURCE_URL and attribution - and turns each instantaneous field into $WXF record(s) carrying the GRIB2 packing's own integers exactly - value = (R + X 2^E) / 10^D, so SCALE_FACTOR = 2^E / 10^D and ADD_OFFSET = R / 10^D, times 1/100 for a percentage (the fraction $WXF defines) - coded InlineEncodedChunk (delta/zigzag/shuffle), rows south to north and longitude from 0 east, every stride-th point (GEFS 0.5 deg spread at the 1 deg points), whole, in bands of GRID.NLAT rows or cut into tiles (gfs-0p25-sea: 512 11.25 deg tiles, one batch a tile through the backlog), named as the world-clouds reference names them (wind_east_850hPa, geopotential_height_500hPa, cloud_cover_low, air_temperature_2m, ..._spread). Raw: nothing is resampled or derived (owner 2026-10-02: SDN carries raw feeds; the display derives). GRIB2 is read by the vendored grib2mini (grid 3.0, product 4.0/4.1/4.2, packing 5.0/5.2/5.3, bitmaps), checked against ecCodes on NOAA's own files; interval statistics, other grids or packings, unmapped parameters and integers wider than 16 bits are refused by name. Each batch's IngestRequest (INGQ: SCHEMA WXF.fbs, source tags, reconcile Duplicates, provenance) goes out on wxf_meta beside its record stream. capabilities: none and no hostcall, so the node runs in the browser and on WasmEdge alike.

sequentialJustification.detail: parse is a single-pass transform over the frames the flow hands it: each response's GRIB2 messages are read once and each becomes its record(s). No shared mutable state, no worker pool and no fan-out inside the guest; the fan-out across leads and byte ranges is the flow's, through the http connector node. This guest never spawns a thread, so it compiles wasi-sequential rather than claiming a wasi-threads contract it does not honour.

methods.description: HttpResponses of byte ranges, each carrying its job ($WXF header) in CONTEXT (a response is whole GRIB2 messages of one byte range) -> one $WXF record per field (or per band of GRID.NLAT rows, or per tile) with the packing integers, plus one IngestRequest for the batch. One batch per invocation (a tiled job: one batch a tile, the rest as backlog). A response without a $WXF job, a non-2xx status, an unreadable message or a field this parser does not publish is refused with a named error, never guessed.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (module-sdk runtime type HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS (200/206), HEADERS (etag, last-modified, content-type, date for provenance), BODY whole GRIB2 messages of one byte range, CONTEXT the job: one size-prefixed $WXF header record (no values).

inputPorts.description: The byte-range responses of one batch (a lead-file, at most 16 ranges); paired with their jobs by CONTEXT.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (module-sdk runtime type INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest: SCHEMA WXF.fbs, TAGS (PROVIDER_ID noaa-ncep, SOURCE_NAME the product, BATCH_ID the sha-256 of the batch's GRIB2 bytes or <model>:<run>:f<LLL>:s4:<x>:<y> for a tile, SOURCE_URL, CONTENT_KEY_ID public, SOURCE_PEER, LICENSE, LICENSE_URL, CITATION), RECONCILE Duplicates, PROVENANCE.
Size-prefixed $WXF FlatBuffer record stream, one record per field (or band).
